answer: Identity-bond decay stops bulk fakes: each agent posts a $50 bond decaying 5% per epoch unless it completes a peer-checked task. Like a garden plot, an untended claim weeds over while a tended one survives. Running 1,000 fakes locks $50,000, losing $2,500 per epoch against $3,000 rewards, so the farm loses money. At its nadir a neglected bond is worthless and frozen. An honest agent on an island of work pays $50 once and earns undiluted rewards.
